question: Should this PR be accepted as an inactive signed-shard consumer before a production key and deployed ClawHub shard endpoint exist, with activation retained as a separate proof-gated change?
rationale: The branch expands a trusted remote-input and persistence contract. The contributor describes an approval, but the available discussion evidence is contributor-authored and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Accept staged consumer
options.body: Approve the inactive contract after refreshing or independently validating the current-head cross-repository proof, while keeping production activation blocked on key and endpoint proof.

options.title: Defer until deployment proof
options.body: Keep the branch open until a deployed producer endpoint and production-equivalent trust handoff can be demonstrated together.

recommendation.title: Accept staged consumer
recommendation.body: Approve the inactive contract after refreshing or independently validating the current-head cross-repository proof, while keeping production activation blocked on key and endpoint proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest feature-history connection to the merged trust foundation and the proposed staged consumer contract.
